effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage with a Light or Heavy Attack, you summon an animated weapon to attack your enemies for |cffffff15|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. 

The animated weapon attacks once every |cffffff2|r seconds. Its Light Attack deals 422 Physical damage, while its Heavy Attack deals 422 Physical damage in a cone in front of it. The damage scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.
